setting: A small coffee shop in central Moscow at mid-morning, not busy. The tutor is the barista; the learner has just come up to the counter.

expect.meaning: asks politely for a coffee or another drink
asks the difference or doesn't know

goal.en: Say that's all and ask how much it is.

expect.meaning: says nothing else, without asking the price

goal.en: Pay and hand over the money.

gloss.en: Good afternoon! What will you have to drink?
Hello! What can I get you?

what-easy.text: Что вы хотите? Кофе или чай?

gloss.en: What would you like? Coffee or tea?

sizes.text: Маленький — двести рублей, большой — двести пятьдесят.

sizes-easy.text: Маленький стоит двести. Большой стоит двести пятьдесят.

gloss.en: The small costs 200. The large costs 250.
Two hundred roubles. Here, on the screen.
Thank you! Have a good day!

setting: A street near Kurskaya station in Moscow. The learner has stopped a friendly passer-by to ask for the metro.

goal.en: Excuse yourself and ask where the metro is around here.
goal.ko: 실례한다고 하고 이 근처 지하철이 어디 있는지 물어보세요.

expect.meaning: only says yes or excuse me

goal.en: Ask them to speak more slowly.

expect.meaning: says it's fine or asks to repeat
also asks where a toilet is

gloss.en: Yes? Can I help you with something?
Of course. What are you looking for?
What are you looking for? The metro?

dir.text: Метро? Идите прямо, потом направо, у аптеки.

gloss.en: The metro? Go straight, then right, by the pharmacy.
gloss.ko: 지하철요? 쭉 가다가 오른쪽, 약국 옆이에요.

gloss.en: Oh, sorry. Am I speaking fast?

slow.text: Хорошо. Прямо... потом направо... у аптеки.

gloss.en: OK. Straight... then right... by the pharmacy.
gloss.ko: 네. 직진… 그다음 오른쪽… 약국 옆이요.

near.text: Пожалуйста. Это близко, пять минут пешком.

gloss.en: You're welcome. It's close, five minutes on foot.
There's a toilet in the metro, downstairs.
The toilet is in the metro.

setting: A small souvenir shop on Arbat Street in Moscow. The learner is looking for fridge magnets.

goal.en: Ask if they have fridge magnets.

expect.meaning: asks if they have magnets or postcards

goal.en: Ask what that second thing is.

expect.meaning: asks the price of a magnet straight away

goal.en: Ask how much a magnet costs.
Say you don't need a bag.

gloss.en: Of course, have a look. Ask if you need anything.

yes.text: Да, вот магниты. А вот тульские пряники.

gloss.en: Yes, here are the magnets. And here are Tula gingerbreads.
gloss.ko: 네, 자석 여기 있어요. 그리고 이건 툴라 프랴니크예요.

gloss.en: Here are magnets. And here are pryaniki.

pryanik.text: Это такое сладкое печенье. Очень вкусно!

gloss.en: It's a kind of sweet biscuit. Very tasty!
gloss.ko: 달콤한 과자 같은 거예요. 아주 맛있어요!

price-easy.text: Один магнит стоит сто пятьдесят рублей.

gloss.en: There are small ones, 100 roubles each.
OK. Do you need a bag?
Here you go. Thank you for your purchase!

setting: The front desk of a small hotel on Nevsky Prospekt in St Petersburg, in the evening. The learner has a booking for two nights. The receptionist's name badge says Olga.

goal.en: Greet her by name and say you have a booking.

match: добрый вечер, ольга. у меня бронь

expect.meaning: only says they have a booking
says their name with the full sentence

goal.en: Hand it over and say it's your passport.
Ask where the lift is around here.

hello.text: Добрый вечер! Меня зовут Ольга. Чем могу помочь?

gloss.en: Good evening! My name is Olga. How can I help?

hello-easy.text: Здравствуйте! Я Ольга. У вас есть бронь?

gloss.en: Hello! I'm Olga. Do you have a booking?

found.text: Да, вот. Две ночи. Ваш паспорт, пожалуйста.

gloss.en: Yes, here it is. Two nights. Your passport, please.

room.text: Спасибо. Ваш номер — триста два, третий этаж.

gloss.en: Thank you. Your room is 302, third floor.
Yes, there is. The password is on the card.
Yes. The password is here, on the card.

breakfast.text: С семи до десяти, на первом этаже.

gloss.en: From seven to ten, on the ground floor.
Breakfast is from seven to ten.
The lift is over there, on the right. Enjoy your stay!
You're welcome. Have a nice evening!

setting: A language-exchange evening at a café in Kazan. The tutor is Dasha, a friendly university student who starts the chat with the learner.

goal.en: Greet her and say your name.
Say what you are: a student, or your job.
Ask her the same question back.

hi.text: Привет! Ты тоже на языковой обмен? Я Даша.

gloss.en: Hi! Are you here for the language exchange too? I'm Dasha.
gloss.ko: 안녕! 너도 언어 교환하러 왔어? 난 다샤야.

askname.text: Очень приятно! А как тебя зовут?

gloss.en: Nice to meet you! And what's your name?
Nice to meet you! Where are you from?

from-easy.text: Ты откуда? Из Кореи? Из Китая?

gloss.en: Where are you from? Korea? China?

job.text: А я из Казани. Ты учишься или работаешь?

gloss.en: I'm from Kazan. Do you study or work?
gloss.ko: 난 카잔 출신이야. 너는 학생이야, 일해?

gloss.en: Do you study? Or do you work?

me.text: А я учусь в университете, изучаю английский. А ты что здесь изучаешь?

gloss.en: I'm at university, studying English. And what are you studying here?
gloss.ko: 난 대학에서 영어 공부해. 너는 여기서 뭐 공부해?

end.text: Класс! Ой, начинается. Потом поговорим, пока!

gloss.en: Cool! Oh, it's starting. Let's talk later, bye!
gloss.ko: 멋지다! 아, 시작한다. 이따 얘기하자, 안녕!

setting: A friend's flat in Novosibirsk. The tutor, a friend called Kostya, is looking at a family photo on the learner's phone.

expect.meaning: says it is my mum / sister
match: это моя мама, а это мой папа

expect.meaning: says they have a brother or sister
match: у меня есть брат и сестра

expect.meaning: says it's the family's or a sister's

gloss.en: Wow, what a photo! Who's this?
gloss.ko: 와, 사진 좋다! 이 사람 누구야?

sibs.text: Красивая! А у тебя есть брат или сестра?

gloss.en: Beautiful! And do you have a brother or sister?
Do you have a brother? A sister?

alone.text: А, понятно. Я тоже один в семье.

gloss.en: Ah, I see. I'm an only child too.
I see. I don't have any either.
And whose dog is this? Yours?
gloss.ko: 그럼 이 강아지는 누구 거야? 네 거야?

like-easy.text: Ты любишь собак? Да или нет?

gloss.en: Do you like dogs? Yes or no?
Me too! Show me more photos!

end2.text: Понятно. А я очень люблю собак!

gloss.en: I see. And I really love dogs!

setting: A small café in Yekaterinburg. Two new friends chat over tea about food. The tutor is Lena, a new friend.

goal.en: Say you like tea and don't like coffee.
goal.ko: 차는 좋아하고 커피는 안 좋아한다고 하세요.

match: я люблю чай, а кофе не люблю

goal.en: Say a Korean food you like.
Say you don't like it, honestly.

gloss.en: Listen, are you hungry? Want some bliny?

order-easy.text: Ты хочешь блины? Да или нет?

gloss.en: Do you want bliny? Yes or no?

bliny.text: Это такие тонкие блинчики. Очень вкусные!

gloss.ko: 얇은 팬케이크 같은 거야. 진짜 맛있어!

filling.text: Отлично! С чем? С мясом или со сметаной?

gloss.en: Great! With what? Meat or sour cream?
gloss.ko: 좋아! 뭐 넣어서? 고기, 아니면 스메타나?

smetana.text: Сметана — это как густой белый йогурт.

gloss.en: Smetana is like thick white yoghurt.
gloss.ko: 스메타나는 걸쭉한 하얀 요구르트 같은 거야.

tea.text: А что ты больше любишь: чай или кофе?

gloss.en: What do you like more: tea or coffee?
gloss.ko: 넌 뭐 더 좋아해? 차, 아니면 커피?

korea.text: А в Корее ты что любишь есть?

gloss.en: And in Korea, what do you like to eat?
gloss.ko: 그럼 한국에선 뭐 먹는 거 좋아해?

gloss.en: What do you like to eat?
I see! And do you like borsch?
Borsch? Do you like it or not?
Ha, got it! Well, let's eat.

setting: A weekend sports club in a park in St Petersburg. The tutor, Igor, is a club member welcoming the learner on their first visit.

goal.en: Greet him by name and say yours.
goal.ko: 그의 이름을 불러 인사하고 내 이름을 말하세요.

goal.en: Say you work at a school.
Ask him back what he does here.
goal.ko: 그는 여기서 뭘 하는지 되물어 보세요.

hi.text: Привет! Ты новенький? Я Игорь.

gloss.en: Hi! Are you new? I'm Igor.
Hi! I'm Igor. Who are you?
Nice to meet you! Can you swim?
Swimming — can you? Yes or no?
gloss.ko: 수영 — 할 줄 알아? 응, 아니?

job.text: А ты работаешь здесь, в Питере?

gloss.en: And do you work here, in Petersburg?

gloss.ko: 또 뭐? 물어보고 싶은 거 있어?

me.text: Я? Я играю в футбол и немного в теннис.

gloss.en: Me? I play football and a bit of tennis.
gloss.ko: 나? 난 축구하고 테니스도 조금 해.

gloss.en: Right, let's go play! Come on!

setting: An office kitchen in Moscow at 9 a.m. The tutor, Marina, is a colleague making tea and chatting about the learner's daily routine.

goal.en: Say good morning and that you're fine.
Say you get up at six.

expect.meaning: gets up at seven or eight
says they are in a hostel or hotel

goal.en: Agree to have lunch at one.

hi.text: Доброе утро! Как дела?

up.text: Отлично. А ты во сколько встаёшь?

gloss.en: Great. What time do you get up?

up-easy.text: Ты встаёшь в семь? В восемь?

gloss.en: Do you get up at seven? At eight?

early.text: Ого, рано! А я в восемь.

gloss.en: Wow, early! I get up at eight.

early-easy.text: Это рано. Я встаю в восемь.

gloss.en: That's early. I get up at eight.
And where do you live now?
Do you live in Moscow? Far away?

far.text: Понятно. А на работу на метро?

gloss.en: I see. And you come to work by metro?

lunch.text: Слушай, пойдём обедать вместе? В час?

gloss.en: Listen, shall we have lunch together? At one?

setting: The courtyard of an apartment block in Kazan. The tutor, Tatyana, is a new neighbour asking where the learner lives and what is nearby.

goal.en: Say yes, and tell her your name.
Say yes, you like it here.
Ask if there's a pharmacy around here.

hi.text: Здравствуйте! Вы новый сосед?

gloss.en: Hello! Are you the new neighbour?

which.text: Очень приятно! Я Татьяна. В каком подъезде?

gloss.en: Nice to meet you! I'm Tatyana. Which entrance?
gloss.ko: 반가워요! 저는 타티야나예요. 몇 번 현관이에요?

gloss.en: Me too! Is it convenient here?

shop.text: Если что, магазин прямо за домом.

gloss.en: By the way, there's a shop right behind the building.
gloss.ko: 참고로 가게가 바로 건물 뒤에 있어요.

gloss.en: The shop is there, behind the building.
Yes, there's a pharmacy by the metro.
There is a pharmacy. By the metro.

park.text: А парк рядом. Вы любите гулять?

gloss.en: And there's a park nearby. Do you like walking?
Walking in the park — do you like it?

end.text: Ну, если что, я в пятой квартире. До встречи!

gloss.en: Well, if you need anything, I'm in flat five. See you!

setting: An outdoor fruit stall at Danilovsky Market in Moscow on a Saturday morning.

goal.en: Ask how much the apples are.
Ask them to say it again.

expect.meaning: asks for one kilo or a few

hi.text: Подходите! Всё свежее, всё вкусное!

gloss.en: Come on over! Everything's fresh, everything's tasty!

repeat-easy.text: Сто двадцать. Вот, смотрите, на ценнике.

gloss.en: 120. Here, look, on the price tag.
Here you go. Anything else? Pears, bananas?

pears-easy.text: Да, груши есть. Сто пятьдесят рублей.

setting: A small neighbourhood bakery in St Petersburg early in the morning, with pastries in the window.

goal.en: Point at a pastry and ask what it is.

hi.text: Доброе утро! Всё только из печи.

gloss.en: Good morning! Everything's fresh from the oven.
Good morning! What would you like?
That's a ponchik, with jam inside.

setting: A small Russian canteen-style café (stolovaya) in Yekaterinburg at lunchtime. The tutor is the server at the table.

expect.meaning: asks what chicken soup is like

goal.en: Choose one, or ask what the other one is.
goal.ko: 하나 고르거나, 다른 하나가 뭔지 물어보세요.

goal.en: Say that's all and ask for the bill.
goal.ko: 그거면 됐다고 하고 계산서를 달라고 하세요.

hi.text: Добрый день! Вот меню. Что будете?

gloss.en: Good afternoon! Here's the menu. What will you have?
Hello! What do you want to eat?
Yes, we have kvass and mors.
Mors is juice made from berries.

bill.text: Пожалуйста. С вас триста восемьдесят рублей.

setting: A bus stop on a wide street in Kazan in the afternoon. The learner asks someone waiting about the bus to the Kremlin.

goal.en: Excuse yourself and ask where the bus to the Kremlin is.
goal.ko: 실례한다고 하고 크렘린 가는 버스가 어디 있는지 물어보세요.

expect.meaning: asks where the bus to the Kremlin is

goal.en: Say you didn't catch the number.
Ask where to buy a ticket.

hi.text: Да-да, слушаю вас.

bus.text: Кремль? Вам нужен автобус номер шесть.

gloss.en: The Kremlin? You need bus number six.

six.text: Шесть. Один, два, три, четыре, пять, шесть.

gloss.en: Six. One, two, three, four, five, six.

when.text: Он ходит часто, каждые десять минут.

gloss.en: It runs often, every ten minutes.

when-easy.text: Десять минут. Автобус через десять минут.

gloss.en: Ten minutes. The bus is in ten minutes.
The stop is right here. Wait here.
Pay the driver or use a card.
You can pay by card. On the bus.

end.text: Не за что. О, вот он идёт!

gloss.en: Not at all. Oh, here it comes!

setting: A ticket window at Leningradsky station in Moscow. The learner wants to go to St Petersburg on the Sapsan train.

goal.en: Say you want one ticket to St Petersburg.
goal.ko: 상트페테르부르크행 표 한 장 달라고 하세요.

expect.meaning: asks for a ticket to St Petersburg

goal.en: Ask them to speak more slowly.
Say one ticket and ask how much it is.
Say OK and pay by card.

expect.meaning: hands over, saying it's my passport

hi.text: Здравствуйте. Куда едем?

gloss.en: Where are you going? Which city?

time.text: Есть поезд в два часа и в пять.

gloss.en: There's a train at two and at five.

time-easy.text: Поезд в два. Или в пять.

gloss.en: A train at two. Or at five.

time-slow.text: Хорошо. В два... или в пять. Два или пять.

gloss.en: OK. At two... or at five. Two or five.

price-easy.text: Три тысячи. Три, ноль, ноль, ноль.

gloss.en: Three thousand. Three, zero, zero, zero.

end.text: Вот ваш билет. Поезд в два, вагон пять. Счастливого пути!

gloss.en: Here's your ticket. Train at two, carriage five. Have a good trip!
gloss.ko: 표 여기 있어요. 2시 기차, 5호차예요. 좋은 여행 되세요!

setting: A taxi ordered through an app, picking the learner up outside Pulkovo airport in St Petersburg. The tutor is the driver.

goal.en: Say hello and yes, it's you.
Say the hotel address on Nevsky.
Say yes, it's your first time.
Pay by card and say goodbye.

hi.text: Добрый день! Это вы заказывали такси?

gloss.en: Good afternoon! Did you order the taxi?
Get in. Where are we going?

bag.text: Хорошо. Это ваша сумка? Давайте в багажник.

gloss.en: OK. Is this your bag? Let's put it in the boot.
gloss.ko: 네. 이거 손님 가방이에요? 트렁크에 넣을게요.

gloss.en: Is this your first time in St Petersburg?

first-easy.text: Первый раз здесь? Да или нет?

gloss.en: First time here? Yes or no?
Great! It's a beautiful city, you'll like it.
gloss.ko: 좋네요! 아름다운 도시예요, 마음에 드실 거예요.

gloss.en: Here we are. Nevsky, building twenty.
We're here. This is your address.
800 roubles. You can pay by card.
Thank you! Have a good day!

setting: A chain pharmacy (apteka) near a metro station in Moscow in the evening. The learner has a headache.

goal.en: Ask if they have something for a headache.

match: у вас есть что-то от головы
у вас есть таблетки от головы?

goal.en: Pay and thank them for the help.

hi.text: Добрый вечер. Слушаю вас.

gloss.en: Good evening. How can I help?
I see. Has your head hurt for long?

pills.text: Вот, возьмите вот это. Хорошие таблетки.

gloss.en: Here are tablets. They're for headaches.

doctor.text: Тогда лучше к врачу. Но вот таблетки на сегодня.

gloss.en: Then you'd better see a doctor. But here are tablets for today.
gloss.ko: 그럼 병원에 가 보시는 게 좋아요. 일단 오늘 먹을 약 여기요.

doctor-easy.text: Идите к врачу. А сегодня — вот таблетки.

gloss.en: Go to a doctor. And for today, here are tablets.
gloss.ko: 병원에 가세요. 오늘은 이 약 드세요.

setting: A clothes shop in a shopping centre in Nizhny Novgorod. The learner is looking for a warm scarf before winter.

match: здравствуйте, у вас есть тёплый шарф?

goal.en: Say you don't like it much.
Ask how much this one is.
Thank them and go to pay.

hi.text: Здравствуйте! Вам что-нибудь подсказать?

gloss.en: Hello! Can I help you find something?
Hello! What are you looking for?

color.text: Есть. Какой цвет: чёрный, серый, красный?

gloss.en: We have them. What colour: black, grey, red?
gloss.ko: 있어요. 무슨 색이요? 검정, 회색, 빨강?

gloss.en: Here's this one, look. Do you like it?

this-easy.text: Вот шарф. Нравится? Да или нет?

gloss.en: Here's a scarf. Do you like it? Yes or no?
gloss.ko: 목도리 여기요. 마음에 들어요? 네, 아니요?

gloss.en: Then this one, a different one.

price-easy.text: Тысяча двести. Один, два, ноль, ноль.

gloss.en: One thousand two hundred. One, two, zero, zero.
Great. The till is over there.
You're welcome. Have a good day!

setting: The lost-property office (byuro nakhodok) at Kazansky station in Moscow. The learner left a backpack on a train this morning.

goal.en: Say you have lost your backpack.
Say this morning, on the train.
Say there's a laptop and a book in it.
Ask where the office is tomorrow.

hi.text: Бюро находок. Что у вас случилось?

gloss.en: What kind of backpack? What colour?
What's in the backpack? Books? A phone?

found.text: Так... Вот этот? Это ваш рюкзак?

gloss.en: Let's see... This one? Is this your backpack?
gloss.ko: 어디 보자… 이거요? 이거 손님 배낭이에요?

sign.text: Хорошо. Ваш паспорт, пожалуйста, и распишитесь здесь.

gloss.en: OK. Your passport, please, and sign here.
Passport. And a signature, right here.

office.text: Здесь, в этом окне. До семи вечера.

gloss.en: Here, at this window. Until seven p.m.

setting: A tourist information centre in the centre of Kazan. The tutor helps visitors plan what to see.

goal.en: Ask what there is to see.
goal.ko: 볼 만한 게 뭐가 있는지 물어보세요.

goal.en: Ask what the second place is.
Ask when the Kremlin is open.
Ask them to say it more slowly.

hi.text: Добро пожаловать в Казань! Чем помочь?

gloss.en: Welcome to Kazan! How can I help?
gloss.ko: 카잔에 오신 걸 환영해요! 뭘 도와드릴까요?

see.text: Обязательно посмотрите Кремль и улицу Баумана.

gloss.en: Be sure to see the Kremlin and Bauman Street.

bauman.text: Это главная пешеходная улица. Там кафе и магазины.

gloss.en: It's the main pedestrian street. There are cafés and shops there.
gloss.ko: 중심 보행자 거리예요. 카페랑 가게가 있어요.

gloss.en: It's a street. There are cafés and shops.

map.text: Вот здесь, на карте. Десять минут пешком.

gloss.en: Right here, on the map. Ten minutes on foot.
Here, on the map. It's close.

open.text: Кремль открыт с восьми утра до десяти вечера.

gloss.en: The Kremlin is open from 8 a.m. to 10 p.m.

open-easy.text: С восьми до десяти. Каждый день.

gloss.en: From eight to ten. Every day.

setting: The front desk of a city library in Tomsk. The learner wants a library card to borrow books.

goal.en: Say yes, and that you'd like a card.
goal.ko: 네라고 하고 카드를 만들고 싶다고 하세요.

goal.en: Say the street you live on.
Ask how long you can keep a book.
goal.ko: 책을 얼마나 오래 빌릴 수 있는지 물어보세요.

hi.text: Здравствуйте! Вы к нам первый раз?

gloss.en: Hello! Is this your first time here?

card.text: Хорошо, сделаем читательский билет. Как вас зовут?

gloss.en: OK, let's make you a library card. What's your name?
gloss.ko: 좋아요, 도서관 카드 만들어 드릴게요. 성함이 어떻게 되세요?

gloss.en: Thank you. And where do you live?

ready.text: Вот ваш билет. Можно брать три книги.

gloss.en: Here's your card. You can take three books.
gloss.ko: 카드 여기 있어요. 책은 세 권까지 빌릴 수 있어요.

setting: The reception of a fitness club in a business district of Moscow. The learner is thinking of joining.

goal.en: Ask how much a month costs.
Ask if they have a pool.

hi.text: Привет! Добро пожаловать в наш фитнес-клуб!

gloss.en: Hi! Welcome to our fitness club!
gloss.ko: 안녕하세요! 저희 피트니스 클럽에 오신 걸 환영해요!

gloss.en: Hello! Do you want to work out?
A month is three thousand roubles.

hours.text: Мы работаем с семи утра до одиннадцати вечера.

gloss.en: We're open from 7 a.m. to 11 p.m.

hours-easy.text: С семи до одиннадцати. Каждый день.

gloss.en: From seven to eleven. Every day.

what.text: А что вы хотите: зал, бассейн, йогу?

gloss.en: And what do you want: the gym, the pool, yoga?
gloss.ko: 뭐 하고 싶으세요? 헬스, 수영장, 요가?

gloss.en: There's a pool, on the ground floor.

end.text: Готово! Вот ваша карта. Ждём вас!

gloss.en: Done! Here's your card. See you soon!
OK, think it over. Here's our leaflet.
gloss.ko: 네, 생각해 보세요. 안내지 여기 있어요.

setting: The reception desk of a private medical clinic in St Petersburg. The learner has an appointment and is asked to fill in a form.

goal.en: Say yes, you have an appointment.
Say yes, it's your first time.
Say you don't understand the form.

match: извините, я не понимаю эту анкету

hi.text: Здравствуйте. Вы записаны?

gloss.en: Hello. Do you have an appointment?
Are you here for an appointment? Yes?

first.text: Да, вижу. Вы у нас первый раз?

gloss.en: Yes, I see it. Is this your first time with us?

first-easy.text: Первый раз здесь? Да или нет?

gloss.en: First time here? Yes or no?
Then please fill in this form.

help.text: Ничего, я помогу. Где вы работаете?

gloss.en: No problem, I'll help. Where do you work?

wait.text: Спасибо. Доктор примет вас в три часа. Подождите здесь.

gloss.en: Thank you. The doctor will see you at three. Please wait here.
gloss.ko: 감사합니다. 의사 선생님은 3시에 보세요. 여기서 기다려 주세요.

gloss.en: The doctor at three. Wait here.

setting: The entrance hall of a Soviet-era apartment block in Novosibirsk, by the lift. The tutor is Nina Petrovna, an elderly neighbour.

goal.en: Say you live on the fifth floor.
Thank her and say goodbye politely.

hi.text: Ой, здравствуйте! Я Нина Петровна, ваша соседка.

gloss.en: Oh, hello! I'm Nina Petrovna, your neighbour.
gloss.ko: 어머, 안녕하세요! 나는 니나 페트로브나예요, 이웃이에요.

hi-easy.text: Здравствуйте! Я Нина Петровна. Я живу здесь.

gloss.en: Hello! I'm Nina Petrovna. I live here.
gloss.ko: 안녕하세요! 나는 니나 페트로브나예요. 여기 살아요.

name.text: Очень приятно! А вас как зовут?

gloss.en: Nice to meet you! And what's your name?

floor.text: Какое красивое имя! На каком этаже живёте?

gloss.en: What a lovely name! Which floor do you live on?

from.text: А я на втором. Вы откуда к нам?

gloss.en: I'm on the second. Where have you come to us from?
Where are you from? Which country?

korea.text: Из Кореи! Как интересно. Если что нужно — звоните мне.

gloss.en: From Korea! How interesting. If you need anything, call me.
gloss.ko: 한국에서! 재밌네요. 필요한 거 있으면 연락해요.

setting: A language-exchange meetup in an anti-café in Moscow. The tutor is Artyom, who wants to learn Korean.

goal.en: Greet him by name and say yes, you're from Korea.
goal.ko: 그의 이름을 불러 인사하고, 응 한국에서 왔다고 하세요.

match: привет, артём! да, я из кореи

goal.en: Ask him to speak more slowly.

hi.text: Привет! Я Артём. Ты из Кореи, да?

gloss.en: Hi! I'm Artyom. You're from Korea, right?
gloss.ko: 안녕! 난 아르툠이야. 너 한국에서 왔지?

lang.text: Класс! Я изучаю корейский. А ты что изучаешь?

gloss.en: Cool! I'm studying Korean. And what are you studying?
gloss.ko: 멋지다! 난 한국어 공부해. 넌 뭐 공부해?

gloss.en: OK, slowly. Do you... speak... English?

plan.text: Давай так: десять минут по-русски, десять по-корейски?

gloss.en: How about this: ten minutes in Russian, ten in Korean?
Great! Let's start then. Go on, tell me!
gloss.ko: 좋아! 그럼 시작하자. 자, 얘기해 봐!

setting: A Russian language class at a university in Moscow. The teacher has just given a short test; the learner has no pen. The tutor is Sveta, a classmate at the next desk.

goal.en: Politely ask to borrow a pen.

expect.meaning: asks if she has a pen

goal.en: Thank her and say you'll give it back after class.
goal.ko: 고맙다고 하고 수업 끝나고 돌려주겠다고 하세요.

hi.text: Что такое? Ты что-то ищешь?

gloss.en: What's up? Are you looking for something?

paper.text: Пожалуйста! А бумага у тебя есть?

gloss.en: You're welcome! Do you have paper?
Do you have paper? Yes or no?

later.text: После урока. А чей это телефон на полу? Твой?

gloss.en: After class. And whose phone is that on the floor? Yours?
gloss.ko: 수업 끝나고. 근데 바닥에 있는 전화기 누구 거야? 네 거야?

end.text: Не за что! Всё, тихо, учитель смотрит.

gloss.en: No problem! Shh, the teacher's looking.

setting: The learner is outside Mayakovskaya metro station in Moscow, on the phone with a friend, Vanya, who is nearby but can't find them.

goal.en: Say you're at the metro exit, then ask where he is.
goal.ko: 지하철 출구에 있다고 하고, 그는 어디 있는지 물어보세요.

expect.meaning: says where they are and asks where he is
match: я у метро. а ты где?
я здесь, у выхода. где ты?

goal.en: Say what you can see: a café.
Ask him to speak more slowly.

hi.text: Алло! Ты где? Я уже у метро.

gloss.en: Hello! Where are you? I'm already at the metro.
gloss.ko: 여보세요! 너 어디야? 나 벌써 지하철역이야.

gloss.en: And what can you see nearby?
What's there? A café? A shop?

fast.text: Кафе «Шоколадница»? Или магазин? Там есть памятник?

gloss.en: The Shokoladnitsa café? Or a shop? Is there a monument?
gloss.ko: 쇼콜라드니차 카페? 아니면 가게? 거기 동상 있어?

fast-easy.text: Там есть памятник? Да или нет?

gloss.en: Is there a monument? Yes or no?

got.text: Понял! Я рядом. Стой там, я иду.

gloss.en: Got it! I'm close. Stay there, I'm coming.
gloss.ko: 알겠다! 나 근처야. 거기 있어, 갈게.
너 보인다! 나 손 흔들고 있어!

setting: An open-plan office in an IT company in Kazan, 9 a.m. The tutor, Anton, is a colleague arriving at the next desk.

goal.en: Greet Anton by name and say things are fine.
goal.ko: 안톤의 이름을 불러 인사하고 잘 지낸다고 하세요.

match: привет, антон! хорошо, а у тебя?

goal.en: Say yes, it's your new laptop.
Say yes, you're here all day.
goal.ko: 응, 하루 종일 여기 있다고 하세요.

hi.text: О, привет! Как дела? Как выходные?

gloss.en: Oh, hi! How are things? How was the weekend?
gloss.ko: 어, 안녕! 잘 지내? 주말 어땠어?

gloss.en: I get it. Want a coffee?
Listen, is that a new laptop? Yours?
gloss.ko: 있잖아, 그거 새 노트북이야? 네 거야?

cool.text: Класс! А ты сегодня в офисе весь день?

gloss.en: Cool! Are you in the office all day today?
gloss.ko: 좋네! 오늘 하루 종일 사무실에 있어?

cool-easy.text: Ты здесь весь день? Да или нет?

gloss.en: Are you here all day? Yes or no?
gloss.ko: 하루 종일 여기 있어? 응, 아니?

lunch.text: Пойдём обедать? В час или в два?

gloss.en: Shall we go for lunch? At one or at two?

lunch-easy.text: Обед в час? Или в два?

gloss.en: Lunch at one? Or at two?

setting: A metro station in St Petersburg. The learner can't work the ticket machine to top up a Podorozhnik transport card. The tutor is a station staff member.

goal.en: Say yes, you don't understand the machine.
Ask them to speak more slowly.

hi.text: Молодой человек, вам помочь?

gloss.en: Excuse me, do you need help?
Is that your Podorozhnik card? Top it up?
The card. Money onto the card? Yes?
Press here, then hold the card to the reader.

slow.text: Хорошо. Сначала нажмите сюда. Потом карту — вот сюда.

gloss.en: OK. First press here. Then the card — right here.
gloss.ko: 네. 먼저 여기 누르세요. 그다음 카드를 여기 대세요.

gloss.en: How much money? Five hundred? A thousand?
Not at all! Have a good trip!

setting: The corridor of a language school in Moscow, right after the evening class. The tutor, Kirill, is a classmate walking out with the learner.

goal.en: Say you're going to the metro.

expect.meaning: going home or to a café

goal.en: Say you don't understand the homework.

hi.text: Фух, урок закончился! Ты сейчас куда?

gloss.en: Phew, class is over! Where are you off to now?
gloss.ko: 휴, 수업 끝났다! 너 지금 어디 가?

metro.text: Я тоже на метро. Пойдём вместе?

gloss.en: I'm taking the metro too. Shall we go together?

next.text: Слушай, а следующий урок когда? В среду?

gloss.en: Listen, when's the next class? Wednesday?

next-easy.text: Урок в среду? Или в четверг?

hw.text: Ой, а домашнее задание ты понял?

gloss.en: Oh, and did you understand the homework?
Is the homework clear? Yes or no?

hw-help.text: Ничего, я тебе напишу. Ну, мне сюда.

gloss.en: No worries, I'll text you. Well, I go this way.
gloss.ko: 괜찮아, 내가 메시지 보낼게. 자, 난 이쪽이야.

gloss.en: I'll write. I go this way.
Well, I go this way. See you Wednesday!
